spec_match.rationale: The page exercises the exact <camera> capability element (HTMLCameraElement, setConstraints, track/cancel/error events) and separates the explicitly labelled getUserMedia fallback from the native surface.

interactive.rationale: Real controls: the native camera element, a labelled fallback button, and a stop control that reflects track state; the status output updates on every action.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the ChromeStatus summary: a single-capability declarative video-capture control with browser-controlled activation.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported browsers, cancellation, element error, and fallback failure (NotFoundError observed in the headless run) are each surfaced honestly with exact enable steps for the CameraAndMicrophoneElements flag.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5153829504024576 (labelled 'ChromeStatus entry') and the mediacapture-extensions spec section.

conformance.rationale: New v153 feature-level suite (8 assertions) probes the exact IDL surface including a can-return-false HTMLUnknownElement check; the predecessor v152 suite was left untouched.

runtime_evidence.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/capability-elements-camera-and-microphone --no-server passed desktop and mobile after the final edits; both screenshots were read and judged (no overflow, legible, panel honest at 8/8 fail in unflagged headless Chrome). A CDP interaction sweep drove fallback/stop and verified honest NotFoundError degradation with zero console errors, zero exceptions, zero failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Successful track attachment emits showcaseTelemetry.assert('camera-track', kind==='video').

design_system.rationale: All colours come from design-system variables; buttons keep the global background+color pairing; focus-visible outlines are explicit.

accessibility.rationale: Native button/select controls with visible focus outlines, an aria-labelled video preview, and an aria-live status output announcing every state change.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness passed both classes (mobile 360x740 DPR3 + desktop 1280x800) with no horizontal overflow; controls go full-width under 640px. Sub-44px targets flagged on mobile are the shared conformance-panel links, not this demo's controls.

guidanceConsulted.query: declarative media capture element fallback and permission prompt UX
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native interactive elements and semantics for controls; prefer declarative surfaces with honest fallbacks over scripted re-implementations.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The demo keeps the native <camera> element as the primary surface, uses native <button>/<select> for everything else, and labels the getUserMedia fallback explicitly instead of silently substituting it.

guidanceConsulted.query: declarative media capture element fallback and permission prompt UX
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give every control an accessible name and expose changing state through text or a live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The status readout is an aria-live <output>, the preview video carries aria-label, and unsupported state is announced as text including exact flag-enable steps.

summary: v153 refile of the v152 camera-control concept, adapted for the Chrome 153 shipping milestone: milestone references updated, and the unsupported path now names the CameraAndMicrophoneElements runtime flag with exact enable steps. Verified with the responsive-check harness (desktop+mobile OK, screenshots read) and a CDP interaction sweep (fallback + stop + status, zero console errors).
